legend_placements.scope: Lines use uniform s6 endpoints at all h. Black crosses show the separate uniform inner s7 triplets for each control. Combined and near-threshold controls coincide in tau_ubar; the combined line is drawn only in conductivity.

rendering.connections: Straight guides between supplied samples; precision controls are marker-only; no fitted derivative
